identity: WTC Amsterdam, Strawinskylaan 1 (Zuidas): the 1985 complex of towers A-G (B/C 61 m, E 65 m, Tower Ten 78 m added 2018-22) is ONE BAG pand 0363100012096613 (OSM way w277173529, ref:bag matches), about 200 x 95 m, 119 ring vertices, 718 wall facets and ~1,780 roof facets in the 3DBAG LoD2.2 item, heights 7 m to 68 m. The H tower (2004, 105 m, pand 0363100012065344, OSM w27679943) and the I tower lie across the Zuidplein and are separate buildings.
why_held: The 3DBAG shell alone is 5,911 triangles / 74 KB and reads as a stepped grey mass; making it recognisable needs a per-tower facade inventory (reclad glass curtain walls of 2002-04, the glass atrium wall with the WTC logo and the light steel-and-glass canopy) with photographs of each street- and quay-facing face. Only three Commons photographs (atrium wall obliquely, logo close-up, tower H) were found and none shows a whole facade or tells which tower or side it is, so any window grid would be the generic kind the brief rejects. Footprints were prepared (world-trade-center-amsterdam-footprints.json) but no spec, builder, catalogue entry or GLB was committed.
